item.title: Club Injury Update
item.description: Adelaide United wishes to provide the following injury update for defender, Dylan Pierias.

item.title: Andrioli wants Reds to turn draws into three points against Western Sydney
item.description: Adelaide United Head Coach Airton Andrioli says the Reds must turn strong performances into maximum points when they host Western Sydney Wanderers on Friday night, after three consecutive draws in a tightening race for the top six.

item.title: Jovanovic at the double as Adelaide put four past Western Sydney
item.description: Luka Jovanovic scored twice as Adelaide United came from behind to beat Western Sydney Wanderers 4-2 at CommBank Stadium.

item.title: “I feel so blessed”: Andrioli proud as Reds fire four past Wanderers to climb to third
item.description: Adelaide United Head Coach Airton Andrioli said he “feels so blessed” to work with his playing group after the Reds produced a four-goal performance to defeat Western Sydney Wanderers 4-2 at Coopers Stadium on Friday night, moving Adelaide up to third on the Isuzu UTE A-League table.

item.title: “It speaks to the culture we’ve built”: Tsiounis on standards before Canberra trip
item.description: Adelaide United Ninja A-League head coach Theo Tsiounis says the Reds’ response to last week’s draw with Melbourne City has underlined the belief and standards within the squad, as attention shifts quickly to another demanding away test against Canberra United today.

item.title: Late Dewey strike not enough as Reds fall narrowly to Canberra
item.description: Adelaide United suffered a narrow 3-2 defeat to Canberra United at McKellar Park on Sunday afternoon, with a late stunning goal from Sian Dewey not enough to spark a comeback after the hosts edged ahead in a hard-fought contest.

item.title: Young Reds continue to build momentum with win over Comets
item.description: Adelaide United’s Young Reds secured their first win of the RAA NPLSA season on Friday night, edging Adelaide Comets 1–0 at LJ Hooker Park – Mile End (Ellis Park) thanks to a second-half penalty from Joey Garuccio.

item.title: Ilona Melegh Called Up For CommBank Young Matildas AFC U-20 Women’s Asian Cup 2026 Squad
item.description: Adelaide United is thrilled to announce goalkeeper, Ilona Melegh has been selected for the CommBank Young Matildas AFC U20 Women's Asian Cup 2026 Campaign.

item.title: Jovanović Hits Top Form as Golden Boot Race Heats Up
item.description: Fresh off a standout performance in the Reds’ 4-2 win over Western Sydney Wanderers, the young striker scored twice to continue his impressive run in front of goal - taking his tally to nine for the season and placing him firmly in the race for the Golden Boot.

item.title: “We’ll Refresh and Go Again” – Tonkin Confident Reds Will Respond
item.description: Ella Tonkin says Adelaide United are ready to reset and respond as they return home to face the Newcastle Jets Women at ServiceFM Stadium this Saturday.
